response:
FADE IN:

EXT. CASTLE - DAY

The majestic castle of King Reginald III stands tall, its stone walls adorned with the royal crest. But something is amiss. The once-majestic halls are now filled with the eerie glow of old CRT TVs, their screens flickering with distorted images of 80s VHS tapes.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III, a stout man with a thick beard, sits upon his throne, surrounded by his advisors. But instead of the traditional regalia, he wears a pastel pink tracksuit, complete with neon green stripes.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
I have a vision, my friends. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... (he consults a piece of paper)...Vaporwave.

ADVISOR 1
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty?

REGINALD
(nodding)
Yes. The aesthetics of the future. The nostalgia of the past. The... (he searches for the right words)...the "wet" of the digital age.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now filled with retro-futuristic contraptions, including old computers, VHS recorders, and cassette players. The sound of distorted synths and eerie ambiance fills the air.

CUT TO:

INT. THRONE ROOM - DAY

King Reginald III stands before a large screen, displaying a video of a 1980s music video. But instead of the usual bright colors, the video is rendered in a washed-out, VHS-style aesthetic.

REGINALD
(to his advisors)
This is the future, my friends. A future where the boundaries between reality and fantasy are blurred. Where the past and present collide in a swirl of... (he searches for the right words)...neon-lit chaos.

ADVISOR 2
(skeptical)
But, Your Majesty, isn't this just a bit... kitschy?

REGINALD
(laughing)
Kitschy? Ha! This is the future, my friend. This is the essence of Vaporwave.

CUT TO:

EXT. CASTLE GROUNDS - DAY

The castle grounds are now filled with people dressed in retro-futuristic attire, dancing to the beat of distorted synths and eerie ambiance. The air is filled with the smell of old electronics and... (he searches for the right words)...the "wet" of the digital age.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
